title: Montauk experiments behind Stranger Things

tellings.quote: I think even the makers of Stranger Things say that uh it's based off of, you know, the Montauk experiments and I I think it's pretty well established that there were some experiments in Montauk, Long Island.

plain: Secret experiments are said to have been carried out at Montauk, on the tip of Long Island in New York, and these are said to be the inspiration for Stranger Things, a television series about hidden government experiments. Michels tells this himself, saying that "even the makers of Stranger Things" say the show is based on them and that it is "pretty well established that there were some experiments in Montauk," though he does not say what the experiments were or name where he learned it.
